## Quality Checklist

- [ ] Zero Emojis: No emojis in code, comments, commit messages, or documentation.
- [ ] Symmetrical Lifecycle: Any addition in `install.ps1` has a matching removal in `uninstall.ps1`.
- [ ] Dynamic Paths: No hardcoded user directories (e.g. `C:\Users\username`). Uses dynamic environment variables.
- [ ] Standard User Privileges: Verified no administrative elevation (UAC) is required.
- [ ] Manual Verification: Tested installation, launch, and uninstallation on Windows.
